summary.order_method: pairs (predecessor, step) from the reference 'predecessors', both matched, in reference order (max 40); same_order=true if any matched claim of the predecessor reaches any matched claim of the step through the ledger's 'order' edges (transitively, identical claims skipped); false if only the reverse path exists; else not_connected. Pairs where one step's matched claims are a subset of the other's (the ledger merged the two steps into the same claim) are skipped and listed in order_pairs_skipped_merged.
